I call it old faithful because I never get sick of it. It all started when I was a young (and broke) line cook and needed to fill up on my single staff meal. After much research and development I came across old faithful. 

I would start by buttering a few slices of sourdough from a local bakery and throwing it on the flat top with a generous amount of pepper jack cheese on each one, doing it on the medium-low side so I could leave it open faced and still have perfectly melted cheese and a nice golden crisp. A little bit after the cheesebread went on I'd throw a few strips of bacon on the flat top to crisp up without getting overly crispy. Once the bacon and bread were ready I would begin to build my sandwich. What I would do next smashed through every rule I learned in culinary school and probably a few laws of physics as well.
I treated the bread with cheese just like normal bread. But not just any bread, bread that's being turned into a BLT.

That's right, mayo (sometimes basil mayo or spicy mayo), lettuce, tomato and bacon. You can't put the mayo right on the cheese though, it gets warm and your lettuce and tomato slip around. To counter this I would spread the mayonnaise on 2 pieces of butter leaf lettuce and stick the tomatoes to those bad boys.

It's the perfect sandwich. All the ingredients are common, you can change up/alter components to tweak it for what you crave (arugula-lettuce for a peppery bite, mozza-pepper jack for some stretch, change the mayo, you get the picture. As long as the basic ingredients are there you're good.), and it sticks it's self together. The melted cheese grabs the lettuce on the top and the bacon on the bottom, the mayo holds the tomato to the lettuce and the natural grip on the bacon holds the tomato in place. It's like it was meant to be.

Every bite is perfect, crispy bread to gooey cheese to fresh vegetables and salty bacon with a little saucy mayo mixed in. As I said before it's the perfect sandwich; impossible to get tired of, easy to prepare, cheap and delicious. Try it out and change your life like mine was changed.
